::: {.dynamic header="🕹️ Simulation Interactive : Le Flux de Données LangChain"}

::: {.controls header="Entrées Utilisateur (Inputs)"}
Saisissez vos variables. Cliquez sur Exécuter pour voir comment le texte est forgé, généré, puis nettoyé.


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
userInput = "Le chat dort sur le canapé."

viewof persona = window.ui.select({
  label: "Variable {persona} :",
  options: ["Pirate 🏴‍☠️", "Poète 📜", "Corporate 👔"],
  value: "Pirate 🏴‍☠️"
})

viewof runChainBtn = {
  const btn = Inputs.button("⚙️ Lancer la Chaîne");
  btn.querySelector("button").className = "atom-btn";
  return btn;
}

llmResponses = ({
  "Pirate 🏴‍☠️": "Yarrr ! Le greffier pionce sur le pont supérieur !",
  "Poète 📜": "Ô doux félin, reposant paisiblement sur ce divan de velours...",
  "Corporate 👔": "Synergie actée : le collaborateur félin est en phase de stand-by sur l'espace lounge."
})

baseTemplate = "Tu es un assistant. Traduis la phrase suivante en style {persona}.\nTexte : \"{texte}\"\n\nTu dois IMPÉRATIVEMENT formater ta réponse en JSON avec la clé \"traduction\"."
```
:::

::: {.steps-container}

::: {#step1 .terminal-mode .terminal-step data-header="1. PromptTemplate (Remplacement des variables)"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  runChainBtn;

  const graph = document.querySelector(".tpl-dynamic");
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.className = "terminal-content";
  container.style.opacity = "0.3";
  container.style.transition = "all 0.5s";

  if (runChainBtn === 0) {
    if (graph) graph.classList.remove("running");
    document.querySelectorAll(".terminal-step, .sep-step").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("visible"));
    document.querySelectorAll(".marquee-content").forEach(el => el.innerHTML = "");
    container.innerHTML = `<span class="terminal-line idle">> En attente des données...</span>`;
    yield container;
    return;
  }

  if (graph) graph.classList.add("running");
  document.querySelector("#step1").classList.add("visible");
  container.style.opacity = "1";
  container.style.boxShadow = "0 0 15px rgba(42, 161, 152, 0.2)";

  container.innerHTML = `<span class="terminal-line system">// Template initial :</span>
<span class="terminal-line text-sol-base3" id="step1-target"></span>`;
  
  const target = container.querySelector("#step1-target");
  const baseTemplateStr = `Tu es un ${persona}.\nL'utilisateur te demande : "${userInput}".\nFormate ta réponse exclusivement en JSON valide.`;
  
  let i = 0;
  function typeWriter() {
    if (i < baseTemplateStr.length) {
      target.innerHTML = baseTemplateStr.substring(0, i+1).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
      i++;
      setTimeout(typeWriter, 15);
    } else {
      const val1 = `<span class="bg-sol-red-subtle text-sol-red fw-bold rounded px-1">${persona}</span>`;
      const val2 = `<span class="bg-sol-blue-subtle text-sol-blue fw-bold rounded px-1">${userInput}</span>`;
      target.innerHTML = baseTemplateStr
        .replace(persona, val1)
        .replace(userInput, val2)
        .replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
    }
  }
  typeWriter();
  yield container;
}
```

:::

::: {#sep1 .separator .sep-step}
<div class="marquee">
  <div class="marquee-content"></div>
</div>
:::

::: {#step2 .terminal-mode .terminal-step data-header="2. LLM (Génération brute / Raw Markdown)"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  runChainBtn;

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.className = "terminal-content";
  container.style.opacity = "0.3";
  container.style.transition = "all 0.5s";

  if (runChainBtn === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `<span class="terminal-line idle">> En attente de l'étape 1...</span>`;
    yield container;
    return;
  }

  yield container;
  await Promises.delay(3200);

  container.style.opacity = "1";
  container.style.boxShadow = "0 0 15px rgba(211, 54, 130, 0.2)";
  document.querySelector("#sep1").classList.add("visible");
  
  const flatPrompt = baseTemplate.replace("{persona}", persona).replace("{texte}", userInput).replace(/\n/g, ' ');
  const sep1Text = `&nbsp;&gt;&gt;&gt; ${flatPrompt} &nbsp;&gt;&gt;&gt; ${flatPrompt} &nbsp;&gt;&gt;&gt; `;
  document.querySelector("#sep1 .marquee-content").innerHTML = `<span>${sep1Text}</span><span>${sep1Text}</span>`;

  document.querySelector("#step2").classList.add("visible");

  const traduction = llmResponses[persona] || llmResponses["Corporate 👔"];
  const rawLlmOutput = `Bien sûr, voici la traduction demandée :\n\`\`\`json\n{\n  "traduction": "${traduction}"\n}\n\`\`\`\nN'hésitez pas si vous avez d'autres phrases à traduire !`;

  container.innerHTML = `<span class="terminal-line system">// model.invoke(prompt)</span>
<span class="terminal-line text-sol-green" id="llm-target"></span>`;
  const textSpan = container.querySelector("#llm-target");
  
  for (let i = 0; i <= rawLlmOutput.length; i += 3) {
    textSpan.innerHTML = rawLlmOutput.substring(0, i).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
    await Promises.delay(10);
  }
  textSpan.innerHTML = rawLlmOutput.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
  
  await Promises.delay(1000);
  container.style.boxShadow = "none";
}
```

:::

::: {#sep2 .separator .sep-step}
<div class="marquee">
  <div class="marquee-content"></div>
</div>
:::

::: {#step3 .terminal-mode .terminal-step data-header="3. OutputParser (Extraction Regex)"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  runChainBtn;

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.className = "terminal-content";
  container.style.opacity = "0.3";
  container.style.transition = "all 0.5s";

  if (runChainBtn === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `<span class="terminal-line idle">> En attente de l'étape 2...</span>`;
    yield container;
    return;
  }

  yield container;

  const traduction = llmResponses[persona] || llmResponses["Corporate 👔"];
  const rawLlmOutput = `Bien sûr, voici la traduction demandée :\n\`\`\`json\n{\n  "traduction": "${traduction}"\n}\n\`\`\`\nN'hésitez pas si vous avez d'autres phrases à traduire !`;

  const step2Time = 500 + (Math.ceil(rawLlmOutput.length / 3) * 10) + 1000;
  await Promises.delay(3200 + step2Time);

  document.querySelector("#sep2").classList.add("visible");

  const flatLlmOutput = rawLlmOutput.replace(/\n/g, ' ');
  const sep2Text = `&nbsp;&gt;&gt;&gt; ${flatLlmOutput} &nbsp;&gt;&gt;&gt; ${flatLlmOutput} &nbsp;&gt;&gt;&gt; `;
  document.querySelector("#sep2 .marquee-content").innerHTML = `<span>${sep2Text}</span><span>${sep2Text}</span>`;

  document.querySelector("#step3").classList.add("visible");
  container.style.opacity = "1";
  container.style.boxShadow = "0 0 15px rgba(181, 137, 0, 0.2)";
  
  container.innerHTML = `<span class="terminal-line system">// parser.parse(raw_output)</span>
<span class="terminal-line text-sol-green" id="parser-target">${rawLlmOutput.replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</span>`;
  
  await Promises.delay(1500);
  
  const target = container.querySelector("#parser-target");
  
  target.innerHTML = `<span class="text-decoration-line-through text-sol-red opacity-75">Bien sûr, voici la traduction demandée :</span><br>
<span class="text-sol-yellow fw-bold">\`\`\`json</span><br>
<span class="text-sol-base3">{</span><br>
  <span class="text-sol-blue">"traduction"</span>: <span class="text-sol-green fw-bold">"${traduction}"</span><br>
<span class="text-sol-base3">}</span><br>
<span class="text-sol-yellow fw-bold">\`\`\`</span><br>
<span class="text-decoration-line-through text-sol-red opacity-75">N'hésitez pas si vous avez d'autres phrases à traduire !</span>`;
  
  await Promises.delay(2000);
  
  target.innerHTML = `<span class="text-sol-base3">{</span><br>
  <span class="text-sol-blue">"traduction"</span>: <span class="text-sol-green fw-bold">"${traduction}"</span><br>
<span class="text-sol-base3">}</span>`;
  
  const successBadge = document.createElement("div");
  successBadge.className = "terminal-line ok";
  successBadge.innerHTML = "> ✅ Objet JSON prêt pour le code Python/JS";
  successBadge.classList.add("terminal-success-badge");
  container.appendChild(successBadge);
}
```

:::

::: {.results #console-term .terminal-mode data-header="Console d'Orchestration"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  runChainBtn;
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.className = "terminal-content";

  if (runChainBtn === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `<span class="terminal-line idle">> [WAITING] En attente du signal d'orchestration...</span>`;
    yield container;
    return;
  }

  const l1 = `<span class="terminal-line system">> [SYSTEM] Initialisation de la chaîne...</span>`;
  const l2 = `<span class="terminal-line warning">> [PROMPT] Injection des variables : {texte}, {persona}</span>`;
  const l3 = `<span class="terminal-line system">> [LLM] Envoi de la requête au modèle...</span>`;
  const l4 = `<span class="terminal-line">> [LLM] Génération de la réponse en cours...</span>`;
  const l5 = `<span class="terminal-line ok">> [LLM] Réponse reçue (Style: ${persona})</span>`;
  const l6 = `<span class="terminal-line system">> [PARSER] Analyse et nettoyage du JSON...</span>`;
  const l7 = `<span class="terminal-line ok">> [SUCCESS] Pipeline exécuté avec succès.</span>`;

  container.innerHTML = l1;
  yield container;
  await Promises.delay(1000);
  
  container.innerHTML = l1 + l2;
  yield container;
  await Promises.delay(1000); 

  container.innerHTML = l1 + l2 + l3;
  yield container;
  await Promises.delay(1200);

  container.innerHTML = l1 + l2 + l3 + l4;
  yield container;
  await Promises.delay(1000);

  const traduction = llmResponses[persona] || llmResponses["Corporate 👔"];
  const rawLlmOutput = "Bien sûr, voici la traduction demandée :\n\n```json\n{\n  \"traduction\": \"" + traduction + "\"\n}\n```\n\nN'hésitez pas si vous avez d'autres phrases à traduire !";
  const step2Time = 500 + (Math.ceil(rawLlmOutput.length / 3) * 10) + 1000;
  
  await Promises.delay(step2Time - 1500); 
  container.innerHTML = l1 + l2 + l3 + l4 + l5;
  yield container;
  await Promises.delay(1000);

  container.innerHTML = l1 + l2 + l3 + l4 + l5 + l6;
  yield container;
  await Promises.delay(4000); 

  container.innerHTML = l1 + l2 + l3 + l4 + l5 + l6 + l7;
  yield container;
}
```

:::
